response.evidence: These figures come from a manual review of the rows and are approximate. White female applicants were denied in roughly 13 cases, a denial rate of about 8-9%. That is close to the overall sample rate of about 8-10% and to White male applicants. Several White female denials coincide with weak financial indicators: DTI >60% (3 cases), DTI 50%-60% (1 case), or DTI of 46-49% (several cases). Three involve applicants over 74 with small loans. Most White female applicants with comparable DTI, LTV and income were approved, including many with high LTV (90-97%). The data shows no disproportionate denial pattern for White females. However, this dataset lacks credit scores and other underwriting factors, so it cannot fully rule out discrimination.
